name: Hophni (Eli's son)
title: The Corrupt Priest
summary: Hophni was the son of the high priest Eli and served as a priest at the sanctuary in Shiloh. Together with his brother Phinehas, he was known for his godlessness, corruption, and contempt for the Lord's offerings. Their sin led to God's judgment on Eli's house and their death in battle against the Philistines.

keyEvents.title: Contempt for the Lord's Offerings
keyEvents.description: Hophni and Phinehas treated the Lord's offerings with contempt by taking meat before it was properly sacrificed and forcing people to give them whatever they wanted.

keyEvents.title: Sexual Immorality at the Tabernacle
keyEvents.description: The brothers lay with the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting, which was a serious desecration of the holy place.

keyEvents.title: Eli's Gentle Rebuke
keyEvents.description: Eli heard about his sons' wickedness and rebuked them, but they would not listen to their father. God had decided to let them die.

keyEvents.title: The Judgment on Eli's House
keyEvents.description: A man of God came to Eli with a message that both his sons would die on the same day as a sign of judgment against his house.

keyEvents.title: The Ark of the Covenant Taken into Battle
keyEvents.description: Hophni and Phinehas took the Ark of the Covenant into battle against the Philistines, hoping it would bring them victory.

keyEvents.title: Death in Battle Against the Philistines
keyEvents.description: Israel was defeated by the Philistines, the Ark of the Covenant was captured, and Hophni and Phinehas both died on the same day, just as the prophecy had foretold.
